title: micro-runway-handshake-log-apr-2028
content:
Purpose
A very small, timeboxed tracker for sprint-burst handshakes across teams. Mostly a lightweight table for: who to ping, minimal acceptance, immediate blockers, and next follow-up. Use this when there is an ad-hoc change that needs 48–72h visibility and cross-team alignment (not a full RFC).

How to use
- Owner updates their row at least once per day during the runway window.
- Mark "Needs Help" if blocked and add a short Slack ping target.
- If item migrates to >72h, convert to a regular tracker and link the new doc.

Table (columns)
Item | Owner | Team | Priority (H/M/L) | Current status (1-3 word) | ETA | Blocking notes | Next action | Slack ping / contact | Jira/PR

Rows
1. Canary config tweak for eu-west region | Samira Patel | infra | H | rolling (10%) | 2028-04-03 | waiting on IP allowlist from Security | escalate to Sec lead if no reply by EOD | @security-ops (Ana) | JIRA-DEPLOY-431
2. Model-variant fallback mapping for chat-route | Priya Menon | product-hosted-api | H | spec drafted | 2028-04-04 | need kernel perf numbers to choose variant | prod to hand over perf matrix to eng by noon | @eng-serving-runtime (Diego) | GH#998
3. Dedicated capacity burst for SE pilot | Diego Alvarez | solutions-eng | M | sizing in progress | 2028-04-05 | finance to approve one-time commit | finance owner (Liam) to sign-off | @finance (Liam) | JIRA-SALES-77
4. Short-term observability retention bump (7d -> 14d) | Liam O'Connor | observability | M | impact analysis done | 2028-04-06 | cost delta unclear for embeddings metrics | instrument sample route and report by 4/4 | @product-ops (Maya) | JIRA-OBS-210
5. Quick fallback route for Asia region | Ana Kim | platform-engineering | H | emergency patch staged | 2028-04-03 | SSH key mismatch on staging node | rotate key and test; ping se if fails | @sre-oncall | JIRA-PLAT-332
6. Prompt-set regression triage for KB ingest | Marcus Lee | applied-ml | M | collecting failures | 2028-04-05 | missing negative examples set | ask doc team to prioritize examples | @docs-team | GH#1201
7. Billing entitlement check for new customer pilot | Zoe Tran | customer-success | L | verifying contract | 2028-04-07 | legal needs SOW clause tweak | CS to escalate with legal by EOD | @legal (Tasha) | JIRA-CS-88
8. Quick UX copy change on onboarding modal | Emily Park | dev-ex | L | ready for deploy | 2028-04-03 | none | deploy during low-traffic window | @frontend (Ravi) | GH#1015
9. One-off quantization experiment schedule | Haruto Saito | serving-runtime | M | queued on infra | 2028-04-06 | GPUs availability next week only | schedule with infra and reserve | @infra-schedule | JIRA-RUNTIME-66
10. Mini A/B for cache TTL setting | Nia Roberts | optimize | M | hypothesis written | 2028-04-04 | instrumentation gap on route /chat | add metric, then launch test | @opt-engineer | GH#1054

Quick notes
- This sheet intentionally terse. Keep status short, focus on immediate unblock requirements.
- If "Blocking notes" is non-empty, owner should add a 1-line request actionable by a named person/team.
- Do not paste long logs here; link to GH or S3.

Carryover & escalation guidance
- Items that hit >72h with active blockers: schedule 15-min triage in #eng-ops and create a persistent tracker.
- Items that touch infra/security/legal must include a named contact in the "Slack ping / contact" column.

Ad-hoc capture (free text)
- 2028-04-02 09:12 Samira: quick note — IP allowlist has sometimes lagged due to legacy provider escalation steps. If Sec team offline, escalate to Ana directly via phone.
- 2028-04-02 11:05 Priya: kernel numbers outstanding; Diego to re-run perf on smaller batch size, maybe use int8 variant for estimate.
- 2028-04-03 07:45 Diego: finance signoff delayed; Liam to confirm whether we can use reserved short-term credit.

Outstanding questions (to be resolved before runway close)
- Which route(s) qualify for automatic fallback vs manual change? (action: product-hosted-api + serving-runtime)
- Do we want a temporary policy that extends observability retention for only routes with "pilot" tag? (action: observability + product-ops)

Links & artifacts
- Perf matrix (internal): confluence:micro-runway-notes-v2
- Staging logs: s3://redwood-staging/logs/micro-runway/2028-04-02
- Small PRs referenced above (GH#998, GH#1015, GH#1054, GH#1201)

Finish checklist (owner)
- [ ] Confirm ETA updated
- [ ] Add final post-mortem note if runway caused an incident
- [ ] Convert to main tracker if work continues >72h

Last updated: 2028-04-05 09:20 by Samira Patel
